newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish furniture maker postpones IPO, bourse debut.
newsitem.headline: Polish furniture maker postpones IPO, bourse debut.

text.p: Polish medium-size furniture maker Fameg SA shareholders decided to postpone the firm's initial public offering and bourse debut, said National Investment Fund (NFI) No 4, which holds a 33 percent stake.

NFI 4 said in a statement Fameg, which seeks the parallel market's listing, was likely to report lower profit than earlier expected because of an accountancy operation, required by recent regulations of the Polish law.
It did not say when Fameg shares could be issued and be listed on the bourse. @
Earlier Fameg said it planned a public share offering in the first quarter of next year.
The furniture maker netted 3.7 million zlotys in 1995 on sales of 87.1 million zlotys.
